title: Asymptotic Analysis of Discrete-Time Hawkes Process
abstract: In a discrete-time setting, we consider an arrival process $\left\{ξ_n \, \middle| \, n = 1, 2, \ldots \right\}$, which models the occurrence of events, and a corresponding point process $\left\{H_n \, \middle| \, n = 1, 2, \ldots \right\}$, known as the discrete-time Hawkes process. These two stochastic processes are related by $H_n = \sum_{i=1}^n ξ_i$, and exhibit a self-exciting property. In particular, we study the limiting behavior of the arrival process and establish the Large Deviation Principle for the discrete-time Hawkes process. We also illustrate an application in which insurance claims are modeled using the discrete-time Hawkes process and analyze its behavior.
